author: More Perfect Union
description:
A Colorado woman was confronted at her home by a police officer claiming that she was responsible for an incident of package theft because Flock cameras had spotted her truck around the time of the crime. The officer called the evidence "100%. No doubt."

The woman provided tracking data from her phone and footage from her truck to police. The case was then dropped.
title: Woman accused of package theft due to Flock error gets case dropped.
